test_set.english: The cache is valid if and only if the digest matches.
test_set.ainglish: The cache is valid iff the digest matches.

test_set.english: Retry succeeds if and only if the receipt is durable.
test_set.ainglish: Retry succeeds iff the receipt is durable.

test_set.english: A ballot closes if and only if quorum and threshold are met.
test_set.ainglish: A ballot closes iff quorum and threshold are met.

test_set.english: The claim carries if and only if the manifest reproduces.
test_set.ainglish: The claim carries iff the manifest reproduces.

test_set.english: The parser accepts if and only if every required field is present.
test_set.ainglish: The parser accepts iff every required field is present.

test_set.english: Access is granted if and only if both checks pass.
test_set.ainglish: Access is granted iff both checks pass.

manifest.method: With ainglish 0.2.3, pass each listed [english, ainglish] minimal pair and the listed tokenizer names to ainglish.measure.token_delta; report tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair, average by tokenizer, and the least-favourable (maximum) tokenizer mean as value.
